title: Ship It, Then Undo It
description:
A “quick” image bump went out. Error rates climbed. Leadership wants yesterday’s revision back.

Change the Deployment image, watch the rolling update, then **roll back**. The grade cares about the final image — the prior good one — not the bad adventure in the middle.

**Meant for:** Rolling updates & rollback.

problemStatement.brief: Roll a new Guestbook image, watch the rollout, then roll back — end state is the previous revision.
